d: Justlife (previously Justmop) is the Middle East’s leading marketplace for home cleaning, beauty & wellness, and other home services such as laundry, maintenance & repairs, upholstery cleaning, pest control & disinfection, moving and packing, and car cleaning, and more. Justlife’s long-term vision is to become a super app for everything related to home services. When a customer books a cleaner or driver, they’re not just booking a service - they’re trusting us to show up.

Our Mission: We promise our customers stellar service, our suppliers a valuable partner, our professionals a better life, and our employees a work environment where they can be the best versions of themselves. Our mission contributes to having a fulfilling workplace for the tribe.

As an Operations Manager - Supply & Fulfilment, you will be responsible for both strategic planning and hands-on operational execution along with managing the outsourced agent team. You’re the central point of contact for fulfilment excellence across the UAE, touching thousands of bookings every week.
You’ll love this role if you...
You get into raw data, diagnose root causes, and fix the structure - not just the symptom
You’re equally comfortable going to the details (van calendars, attendance, timing changes in the CRM) and big-picture strategy (service launches, seasonal planning, demand forecasting)
You have an obsession with automation and setting up ops processes to streamline execution
You work collaboratively with other stakeholders (both internal and external)
You own the metrics and projects end to end and take decisions independently to fix and improve
Manage supply distribution in different micro-markets across all cities to rebalance capacity based on demand patterns
Lead and manage the outsourced agent team: assign tasks, track weekly productivity (tasks per agent, turnaround time, quality), and identify automation opportunities to lift their output

Own fulfilment metrics end-to-end: delivery %, cancellation %, utilisation and capacity by hub and zone. You’ll report on these weekly, analyse trends by service type, and drive improvement through both daily execution and structural fixes
Manage van operations: calendars, professional attendance, timing changes and operational scheduling.
Automate repeatable processes: identify manual workflows, build or implement solutions
Execute key projects end-to-end: new service launches, seasonal demand and supply planning cycles, and vacation planning. You’ll own timelines, stakeholder coordination and on-time delivery
What tells us you’re the one
You have 4–6+ years in operations, supply planning, fulfilment or last-mile delivery, ideally in a marketplace, home services or logistics business.
You’ve demonstrated extreme ownership and measurably improved operational metrics across a scaled operation
You’ve been tried and tested on problem-solving skills and worked on large operational data to drive insights
You’ve a strong bias for action - you diagnose the issue, then go and fix it on the ground
You’ve managed a team or outsourced workforce before and you know how to track performance, set clear expectations and automate what’s repeatable
You’re based in or willing to relocate to the UAE. You speak English fluently. UAE experience in home services, facilities management or last-mile delivery is a plus, not required

Scale and impact: Your work directly touches thousands of bookings every week across multiple service types. Delivery % and cancellation % improvements show up in customer satisfaction, repeat bookings and revenue
Real growth: You’ll move into larger scope as we expand across the GCC. Fulfilment is core to our scaling strategy, and exceptional performance here opens doors to leadership roles
Ownership and autonomy: You own the metrics and the levers. No micromanagement. You diagnose, you decide, you execute
A fair, objective performance system: Monthly KPI-based bonus. Clear metrics, clear payoff. Recognition through our JustHeroes program for impact that matters
Start-up spirit, plus perks: a birthday day off (JustHoliday), free Justlife credits, referral bonuses, team experiences and mentorship from founders and leadership
Join the tribe and let’s become #everydaybetter, together.

Your role involves addressing plumbing issues promptly, conducting inspections, and collaborating with the Engineering team to uphold safety and functionality standards.

li

li

li

li
